reading.body:
QTS Hillsboro 2 is a 51 acre campus in Hillsboro, Oregon with 180 MW or more of total power capacity across four buildings. This specific facility record cannot be matched to a single building on the campus, as four distinct addresses on Northeast Huffman Street exist within 400 meters of each other and share the same generic name in available sources. The campus total of 180 MW would support roughly 4,500 racks at 40 kW per rack, a common density for AI training infrastructure, though the actual distribution across the four buildings is not published.

The campus sits in Oregon's largest published data center footprint. Eight facilities in Oregon have published power figures totaling 156.6 MW, and this campus alone accounts for 180 MW, making it the largest single facility in the state by that measure. Hillsboro hosts multiple major operators including Digital Realty and Verizon alongside QTS, reflecting the region's established position in the industry.

The campus belongs to QTS Data Centers, acquired by Blackstone for approximately 10 billion dollars in 2021 and taken private. No certifications, grid interconnection details, cooling specifications, or tenant information are published for this facility. The specific building address needed to map this record to one of four distinct structures on the Hillsboro 2 campus is not in the data provided.
